subject.title: [Bug]: Notarized macOS app auto-terminates ~0.5s after launch (no menu-bar icon) in remote mode — macOS 26

question: Should this issue stay gated on maintainer-run notarized macOS 26 remote-mode reproduction before any fix PR is queued or the issue is closed?
rationale: The likely fix area depends on official signing/package behavior that source inspection and local debug-app proof do not settle.

options.title: Run notarized macOS 26 repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require official release-package launch proof before scoping a repair.

options.title: Accept adjacent menu-bar fix as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers already have external proof that v2026.6.11 or current notarized builds stay resident in the reported remote-mode setup.

options.title: Queue speculative code repair
options.body: Start a fix before reproducing, with higher risk of touching the wrong lifecycle, signing, or status-item layer.

recommendation.title: Run notarized macOS 26 repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require official release-package launch proof before scoping a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and supplied proof for the adjacent macOS lifecycle/menu-bar fixes and is the strongest available owner for release-package proof decisions.
